subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: How should this Discord retry compose with the shared reply-session self-heal proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both paths recover the same conflict at different ownership layers, and repository evidence cannot determine whether repeated channel redispatch after shared recovery is desired defense in depth or duplicated lifecycle policy.

options.title: Shared owner plus narrow replay
options.body: Use shared recovery as canonical and retain a bounded Discord replay fallback that cannot repeat lifecycle teardown.

options.title: Keep current layered recovery
options.body: Accept immediate Discord redispatch plus queue replay as intentional defense in depth when shared recovery is also present.

options.title: Use shared recovery only
options.body: Pause this PR and reassess the Discord-specific gap after the owner-layer change lands or is rejected.

recommendation.title: Shared owner plus narrow replay
recommendation.body: Use shared recovery as canonical and retain a bounded Discord replay fallback that cannot repeat lifecycle teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR assignment makes steipete the best available owner for the cross-layer merge decision.
